answer: One enforceable rule: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its meadow recurs, its atlas survives audit, and a pearl from an unlinked peer confirms it.
